name: Your Very Own Trophy
source:
Katie seemed to have no choice but to trade in her self for safety.

Turns out, that's not always a permanent decision.

[From [url=https://numbertree.itch.io/yvot]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
为了换取安稳与庇护，凯蒂似乎别无选择，只能交出自我。

事实证明，这未必是一个不可逆转的永久决定。

[摘自[url=https://numbertree.itch.io/yvot]itch.io[/url]]
